items.t: Automatic transmission slipping or failing
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with remanufactured unit
items.note: A used transmission costs less but carries more risk.

items.t: Harsh or jerky shifts
items.job: Diagnose and replace transmission solenoid or pressure control parts
items.note: If the clutches are already worn, a rebuild or replacement is needed instead.

items.t: Power sliding door reopens or will not latch
items.job: Repair or replace power sliding door motor, cable or latch
items.note: Sometimes only an adjustment or latch is needed.

items.t: Coolant leak from engine gaskets
items.job: Replace intake manifold and coolant crossover gaskets

items.t: Rear trailing arm can crack (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if the recall is still open on your VIN.

items.t: Alternator or charging system failure
items.job: Replace alternator
items.note: Test the battery too; a worn battery adds about $120–220.

items.t: ABS, traction or StabiliTrak light comes on
items.job: Replace wheel speed sensor or wheel hub with sensor
items.note: Diagnosis first; the fault code tells which sensor is bad.

items.t: Will not start with "starter locked" message
items.job: Diagnose theft deterrent system; replace ignition switch or lock cylinder

items.t: Engine stalls while driving
items.job: Diagnose stalling; repair fuel pump, ignition or computer fault
items.note: Wide range because the cause varies. A fuel pump module is the costly end.

items.t: Power steering goes stiff in wet weather
items.job: Replace serpentine belt, tensioner and idler pulleys

items.t: Clunk or knock when turning the wheel
items.job: Replace intermediate steering shaft or tie rod ends
items.note: Add an alignment (about $100) if tie rods are replaced.

items.t: Fuel gauge reads wrong or low fuel light stays on
items.job: Replace fuel pump module with level sensor
items.note: Some gauge problems are fixed by a cheaper sensor or connector repair.

items.t: Gasoline smell from cracked fuel line on tank
items.job: Replace fuel tank module

items.t: Humming or grinding wheel bearing
items.job: Replace front wheel hub and bearing assembly

items.t: Weak heat at idle
items.job: Find coolant leak, refill and bleed cooling system
items.note: A heater core flush or replacement costs more.

items.t: Water on the floor from A/C drain
items.job: Clear A/C evaporator drain tube

items.t: Oil leak at oil pan or front crank seal
items.job: Replace front crankshaft seal or oil pan gasket

items.t: Brake pedal pulsation or vibration
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors

items.t: Parking brake can slip (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if the recall is still open on your VIN.

items.t: Rear seat latch can release in a side crash (recall)
items.job: Dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if the recall is still open on your VIN.

items.t: Rear wiper stops working
items.job: Replace rear wiper motor

items.t: Check engine light from gas cap
items.job: Replace gas cap
